summary: Frontend-only mobile regression pass. Expo loaded without runtime errors; setup, toss, finite-series settings, board completion, rules opening, and theme tap were exercised. The tie-break scenario was not valid because the test awarded five points per board and produced a non-tie; no tie-break behavior is claimed.

issues: Prior confirmed issue remains: Unlimited mode formats the active eyebrow as BOARD N OF 00; SeriesStatus shows the correct unlimited label.

action_items: Fix the Unlimited active header formatting from OF 00 to an Unlimited-specific label.
Run a valid tie-break regression using one point per alternating board, then verify the deciding board awards the set.
critical_code_review_comments: Active() still unconditionally pads boardsPerSet, so boardsPerSet=0 renders OF 00.
The tie-break state logic was not conclusively tested in this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 75% of executed checks passed; valid tie-break not executed

context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, use men decrement to 1 and alternate winner A/B for eight boards to produce a true tie. Settings and rules modals require scroll_into_view_if_needed before tapping lower controls on mobile web.
rca_of_issue: The attempted tie-break test selected the default five opponent men, so each board scored five points; it was a test setup error rather than evidence of a scorer defect. Mobile web also requires explicit viewport-safe scrolling for modal controls, including close rules.
